name: Massurrealism
summary: Massurrealism is a portmanteau term coined in 1992 to describe a trend among certain postmodern artists who combine the visual language of surrealism with imagery and techniques drawn from mass media, including pop art.
description: Massurrealism is a portmanteau term coined in 1992 to describe a trend among certain postmodern artists who combine the visual language of surrealism with imagery and techniques drawn from mass media, including pop art. The style reflects the pervasive influence of technology, advertising, and consumer culture, merging dreamlike or irrational elements with familiar symbols from everyday media environments. Massurrealist works often blur the boundary between the subconscious and the mediated reality shaped by contemporary visual culture.
